qc.flag_rule: within-AB-span absolute log(R) > 6 scaled MAD; flag only

units.z: m, positive upward, local datum unknown

qc.unit_basis: synthetic fixture explicitly declares metres, positive-up z, and Ohm resistance

split.rule: within AB-index-span, spatial midpoint order, every fifth from index 4

blocked_split.rule: hold out all A/B midpoints in central 40-60% of profile x extent

weighting.chi_square_meaning: conditional on assumed weights, not instrument-calibrated

inverse.coverage_meaning: pyGIMLi log-Jacobian coverage divided by cell size; not resolution

sensitivity.meaning: diagnostic perturbations only; primary model and held-out gate are not retuned

blocked_validation.meaning: within one profile; shared electrodes remain possible at block edges

synthetic_truth_comparison.interpretation: synthetic truth error is a controlled experiment score, not field accuracy or uncertainty
